site_audit.platform: Hand-written static HTML site (assets/css/style.css, site.webmanifest, inline SVG icons), Plus Jakarta Sans + Inter from Google Fonts, LocalBusiness JSON-LD
site_audit.html_errors: 2 errors, 1 warning, 0 info on the homepage; the same 2 errors and 1 warning on /contact

issues: Your live ad's 'Send message' button goes to instagram.com/sunxsolarsolutions, not to sunxsolarsolutions.in, so the click lands in a social inbox instead of on the site that explains the offer.
The ad tells people to call 8333075151, but the number published on the website is +91 99121 27174 - a caller who reaches one and not the other has no way to tell they reached the same company.
sunxsolarsolutions.in has no Meta Pixel, no GA4 and no Google Ads conversion tag, so the Diwali offer cannot be measured from click to enquiry even once the destination is fixed.
No Meta Pixel installed — can't run retargeting or track ad conversions
No Google Ads / GTM tracking — can't measure ad performance
No Google Analytics — flying blind on website traffic

site_evidence.note: Landing-page source read live on 2026-11-10 through the W3C Nu HTML Checker (validator.w3.org/nu/?doc=<url>&showsource=yes), which returns the served HTML with script tags intact, plus a direct fetch of the same pages. Tags found: no Meta Pixel, GA4, GTM or Google Ads tag.

promise_gap: Ad: 'Diwali special offer ... Silver coin, Fridge, Washing machine, Water purifier, Smart phone. For more details about sunx solar solutions please call 8333075151'.

The offer itself is only on Facebook. sunxsolarsolutions.in publishes no Diwali promotion anywhere in its served HTML, and the number it publishes is +91 99121 27174 - so a visitor who lands on the site cannot find the offer they were shown, and the number in the ad does not match the one on the page.

The site is the better asset - it has a LocalBusiness JSON-LD block with both phone numbers, the Serilingampally address, Mon-Sat 09:30-19:00 hours, a /calculator savings tool and a /sales quote form - but the ad never sends anyone to any of it.

The site is built for exactly this traffic: rooftop grid-tied, hybrid + storage, ground-mount, C&I and O&M pages, a wind-energy page and a projects page. The only thing standing between the ad and those pages is the destination - and, once that is fixed, the absence of any pixel to measure it.

ads_audit.methodology: Control review follows the claude-ads Meta Ads audit catalog (github.com/vamsy16/claude-ads, ads/references/meta-audit.md). Each control is graded only where public evidence establishes it - Ad Library ad data and the lead's own landing page. Controls that require Ads Manager access (bidding, budgets, audiences, learning phase, EMQ, CAPI status) are marked unknown on purpose: they cannot be verified from outside the account and are never guessed.
ads_audit.account_only: M02 Conversions API, M03 event deduplication, M04 Event Match Quality, M06 aggregated measurement, M07 standard vs custom events, M08 CAPI Gateway, M09/M-AT1 attribution windows, M10 data freshness, M13/M14 learning phase, M15/M16 campaign & ad-set structure, M17 budget distribution, M36 bid strategy, M37 frequency caps, M38 breakdown reporting, M40 A/B testing, M19-M24 audiences & first-party data
